events.title: Node.js 10 released
events.summary: Node.js 10.0.0 shipped on April 24, 2018 with improved N-API stability, HTTP/2 support, and V8 6.6.
events.about: Node 10 became LTS in October 2018 — the runtime behind npm's peak growth era. N-API gave native addon authors a stable ABI across Node versions; HTTP/2 enabled faster multiplexed servers without external modules.

narrative.whyChosen: Node 10 LTS powered the JavaScript backend boom of the late 2010s.
narrative.whyImportant: Stable N-API reduced breakage for native modules on every Node upgrade.
narrative.problemSolved: Native addons broke on each V8 bump, blocking enterprise Node adoption.
